verdict.description: Approve only a clear-cut improvement; reject anything doubtful.

clear_cut.description: Whether this could be merged without a team discussion.

confidence.description: Probability from zero to one that the verdict is correct.

behaviour_change.description: Whether observable behavior changes, including the visible result of a UI fix.

risks.description: Concrete potential harms identified by this reviewer.

reasons.description: The reviewer's explanation for the verdict.

concerns.description: Every concern you have, blocking or not; empty when none. A reader of the pull request sees each one with its resolution.

concern.description: The concern, concretely: what could go wrong, where.

blocking.description: True when it alone should stop the merge.

resolution.description: For a non-blocking concern, why it is acceptable as it stands (with what you checked); for a blocking one, what would have to change.
